Billiard halls in Greece

Looking for somewhere to play billiards? Here are 77 halls in 27 cities, each with its address. We researched the directory by hand for RackUp, the app that puts you in touch with other players for a game on a real table.

Find an opponent on RackUp

Post the hall, the game and the time: pool (8-Ball, 9-Ball, 10-Ball), or carom (3-cushion, 1-cushion) at halls with carom tables. See who takes the table, or ask to join a table someone else opened. The feed filters by city, and every month there is a ranking by city and hall.
